note: The projection onto the range of Pi_e is the abstract map `a.step` (`display a x`), and the zero root on the kernel is a decay rate `flight C (-(1/32))` rather than the exact Haar-identity argument written in [M]. The sweep and admissibility facts are the same.

let X:= display a x
  let f i:ℂ:= ((1+‖X i‖ : ℝ):ℂ)⁻¹
  let y:Bid.Rowe C d:=fun i=> f i • X i
  let z:Bid.Rowe C d:=fun i=> f i • (x i-X i)
  have hz i : ‖f i‖=(1+‖X i‖)⁻¹:= by unfold f; rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have hz' i:0 < 1+‖X i‖:= add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg zero_lt_one (norm_nonneg _)
  have hs:∀ i,‖f i‖ ≤ 1:= by intro i; rw [hz]; exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by simp)
  have hT:Coin C z:=by
    have hd: z=f • x - y:= funext fun i=> (show f i • (x i-X i)=f i • x i-f i • X i from smul_sub _ _ _)
    rw [hd]; apply Coin.sub (hx.scaled ((Sluggish.const (C:=C) (1:ℝ)).reduce (Eventually.of_forall (fun i=> by simp [hs])))) (Coin.from_bound M (A:=1) ?_)
    refine Eventually.of_forall (fun i=>?_); unfold y; rw [norm_smul,hz i,mul_comm,←div_eq_mul_inv,div_le_one (hz' _)]
    linarith
  have hD:= sweep M B V R hV a hf z hT (fun i=> by unfold z X display; rw [map_smul,map_sub,a.projected,sub_self, smul_zero])
  have hl:= hS _ _ hD (flown (by norm_num))

proof_context.conclusion: `cap` projects `x` to `X := display a x`, forms `z = (x - X)/(1+‖X‖)`, proves `Coin C z` (admissible) from `Coin C x` and the bounded `y`, and applies `sweep` to get a vanishing-root equation section for `z`.

lemma sweep (x:Bid.Rowe C d)(hx:Coin C x)(he:∀ i, a.step d i (x i)=0): Owed (Bid.upper C x) (flight C (-(1/32))):=by
   obtain ⟨p,q,h⟩:=hf.hearth d
   exact banked M B (V d) R (hV d) _ h _ hx fun i=> ((hf.foundation.step d i.1 i.2).ker) ▸ (show x i∈LinearMap.ker (a.step d i).toLinearMap from LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (he i))

proof_context.conclusion: `sweep` shows an admissible `x` whose projection `a.step d i (x i)` vanishes (the kernel case) has `Owed (Bid.upper C x) (flight C (-(1/32)))`, a root bound tending to zero.

lemma from_bound (h:C.Makes) {A:ℝ} (hp:∀ᶠ i in mesh, ‖p i‖ ≤ A) : Coin C p:=by
  intro ε he
  filter_upwards [deepen.eventually (Work.D01.terminal_ball C h _ A ε he),hp] with i hi hu
  exact hi _ _ hu

proof_context.conclusion: `Coin.from_bound` shows every eventually bounded coefficient family is admissible.
